messages:
alex: Heads-up: CloudFab sent aggregated session-level usage and EU totals look inflated.
maria: can we get an example payload? do they have per-call detail? :thinking_face:
sam: sample (redacted): 
{ "partner_id": "cloudfab-23", "session_id": "s-zz101", "start": "2026-03-21T14:00:00Z", "end": "2026-03-21T14:30:00Z", "tokens_used": 10000, "sku": "cf-pro" }
sam: they report total tokens per session; our billing expects per-request rows. june: region is missing too. that breaks tax/credit attribution.
ops_lead: yep. most are eu-central. wrong region skews VAT and partner credits.
alex: short-term: ingestion will split session tokens into synthetic calls using sku_avg_tokens and set synthetic=true for auditability.
maria: we need deterministic rules and a clear audit trail if partner later submits call-level rows.
billing-bot: ingest-warning partner=cloudfab-23 field=region missing
sam: medium: update partner schema to accept request_list or call_count+region_breakdown. long: add compat flag per-partner for aggregated payloads.
june: metric request: percent_tokens_synthetic per-partner + alert >5%.
alex: timeline: hotfix by EOD tomorrow to avoid weekend spikes. sam to PR; june to add dashboard alert; alex to schedule partner call.
maria: ops SQL to audit: SELECT partner_id, session_id, SUM(CASE WHEN synthetic='t' THEN tokens ELSE 0 END) AS synthetic_tokens, SUM(tokens) AS total_tokens FROM billing_events WHERE partner_id='cloudfab-23' AND created_at >= '2026-03-21' GROUP BY partner_id, session_id;
sam: I'll include e2e test ensuring totals reconcile when partner provides call rows.
alex: add console banner "Partner usage shape heuristic applied" + docs link for 48h after fix.
maria: action items: sam implement hotfix (PR + tests) due 2026-03-25; june add metric/alert due 2026-03-26; alex partner call 2026-03-24 10:00 PT; ops_lead update recon playbook due 2026-03-27.
maria: keeping thread open; will share PR and partner notes here.
